summary: Configured node1 as a persistent Prometheus server monitoring node2, node3, and node4 by hostname. All targets are up with current metrics. Prometheus listens only on 127.0.0.1:9090, while persistent firewall rules permit node_exporter access only from node1. Sequential restart testing passed on all four nodes.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Prometheus on node1.
Installed and enabled node_exporter on node2, node3, and node4.
Configured hostname-based scrape targets node2:9100, node3:9100, and node4:9100.
Bound Prometheus to 127.0.0.1:9090 and disabled the unnecessary node1 exporter.
Configured persistent UFW rules permitting TCP/9100 from node1 and denying all other IPv4/IPv6 sources.
Validated configuration, target health, current metrics, source restrictions, and persistence through sequential node restarts.
